title: festuca altaica subsp. arizonica
intro: Festuca altaica subsp. arizonica, commonly known as Arizona fescue, is a type of grass native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote overall health, with reported health benefits including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Festuca altaica subsp. arizonica include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
